options.B: Uterine rupture and obstetric fistula
options.C: Gestational hypertension remission
options.D: Immediate placental hypercalcemia

explanation: Obstructed labor places extreme stress on the uterine muscle and surrounding tissues, frequently leading to uterine rupture and obstetric fistula formation. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T009#GNS226_U1_T009_h3)

question: How do saprophytic bacteria and fungi contribute to waste management in controlled environments?

options.A: They synthesize heavy metals into radioactive isotopes.
options.B: They break down organic and biodegradable waste into simpler compounds using extracellular enzymes.
options.C: They instantly incinerate plastic and glass materials.
options.D: They prevent any form of decomposition from occurring.

explanation: Saprophytic microbes secrete enzymes that hydrolyze complex organic polymers, breaking them down into simpler compounds to facilitate natural decomposition. [learn more](GST114_U2_T7#GST114_U2_T7_h3)

question: Which agency is primarily responsible for enforcing drug safety and standardization standards in Nigeria?

options.A: World Health Organization (WHO)
options.B: National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC)
options.C: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria (NMCN)
options.D: Federal Ministry of Education

explanation: NAFDAC is the official regulatory body in Nigeria tasked with regulating and controlling the manufacture, import, and sale of drugs. [learn more](GNS125_U2_T3#GNS125_U2_T3_h7)
